intent: Ten individual campus transcript-preparation tasks distinguish hall/rain from shed/tool and notebook/planning roles, current four from old half-past-four, next-week planting from today's planning, teacher's walking request from Ben's unaccepted run proposal, wet-stairs priority, Ben's accepted reporting task, teacher's concurrent reminder role and do-that reference. Four live sentences preserve wrong attempts and require actual premise groups and learner reasoning. Fresh changed-setting/time/roles transfer includes partly correct distractors.
picturePurpose: Exact live sentence models show attempted location, clock time, requested action and reporting subject. Literal short source cards expose role and reference changes. No invented floor plan, real safety conditions or generic decorative image; pictorial location contrast was used in the preceding lesson.

workshop.title: 通知改口与人物分工：听力文字准备
workshop.instruction: 先核对当前通知，再按人物接上请求和回应；正式音频仍待批准。

answer.display: Meet in Room Eight at 3:20; Ari tells reception while Ms Deng stays at the entrance.

explanation.strategy: 先排除旧通知的地点和时刻，再接上学生提议与老师Yes，分清谁去通知、谁留下。

steps.text: 当前是Room Eight、twenty past three，也就是3:20；旧通知的greenhouse、3:50被not排除。
steps.reason: ten to four是差十分钟四点，即3:50，但这里属于旧安排，不能只因听见就采用。

steps.text: Ari提出告诉reception，Ms Deng同意，自己留在入口提醒其他人走。
steps.reason: Shall I...由Ari说出，I will stay由老师说出；while you do that保持两人的同时分工。

distractors.reason: Ari通知、老师留下的分工正确，却把被排除的旧地点greenhouse与旧时间3:50当成当前安排。
Room Eight和3:20正确，却把老师与Ari的任务互换；老师同意的是Ari去通知。

explanation.pitfall: 同一选项里时间、地点和人物分工要全部吻合；先出现或更熟悉的信息不一定仍然有效。
